Sara — thanks for the samples, that was helpful to reproduce several failure modes. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

Proposed high-level acceptance checklist (draft):
- Safety floor: no hallucinated medical advice that contradicts common clinical guidelines (binary pass/fail for sampled prompts).
- Accuracy tolerance: factual recall within 5% of our reference answers on structured items (lab values/units).
- Conservatism for ambiguity: prefer clarifying question or safe fallback when critical action is implied.
- Latency/throughput: 95p latency must be <= 420ms p50 for our sample 256-token payloads (staging).
- Regression delta: no >3% drop in user-satisfaction metric on a control promptset between baseline and candidate.

Proposed A/B rollback triggers (automated + manual):
- Automated: >= 5% relative increase in safety-fail rate across sampled prompts for >= 2 consecutive days.
- Automated: spike in hallucination indicator >4x baseline on the same prompt bucket.
- Manual: >2 escalations from Acme PMs within 48h on clinical-safety prompts.

Next steps I'd like to propose:
1) Consolidate edge-case prompts into a single shared checklist (we can use the Drive link below).
2) Karthik and Marissa to draft the minimal test-run plan and A/B config (control/candidate mapping + sampling).
3) Short triage call Monday morning (30m) to lock the rollbacks and owners.

I've attached a quick diff file showing where the candidate diverges on your samples — Marissa / Karthik, can you take lead on the A/B config doc?

Thanks,
Neha

Adding product perspective and a few concrete thresholds we should agree up-front:

- Acceptance: sample-level pass rate >= 92% across the clinical taxonomy (we'll pick 200 seed prompts).
- Hallucination score: model should score <0.04 on our hallucination classifier on the seeded prompts.
- Clarification rate: candidate should ask to clarify vs guessing on ambiguous instructions >= 60% (for a defined set).

Rollback specifics I recommend:
- Auto-roll: if hallucination classifier trips on >6% of sampled prompts for two consecutive evaluation windows (24h windows), auto-switch to baseline.
- Soft-fail: if degradation is within 3-6% we pause rollout and spin up a human-review cohort.

We also need to lock the sampling strategy: stratified by clinical taxonomy + high-risk bucket oversampling (10x). Karthik, can you post the A/B sampling matrix to HS-12458 and attach the draft to the shared Drive?

One ask for Acme: please attach one or two failing prompts that you consider safety-critical (call them out as "must-block" prompts). We'll prioritize those in the human-review cohort.

—Marissa
